description: Object registers of the 1931-1943 excavation reports (Marshall, Mackay, Vats), OCR transcribed and repaired: object no., findspot, depth, size, material, M77 link.

Vats 1940 (Excavations at Harappa) seal register: size, mound, depth, find no.
Marshall 1931 (Mohenjo-daro and the Indus Civilization) seal register.
Mackay 1943 (Chanhu-daro Excavations) seal list.
Mohenjo-daro seals: parsed block/house/room and depth, linked to M77 text numbers.
Harappa seals (Vats 1940): mound, square, depth, linked to M77/ICIT/CISI.
Findspots stated in the prose of Marshall 1931.
Craft-activity evidence per excavation unit (Harappa, Mohenjo-daro, Lothal, Dholavira) with sources.
Per excavation unit: crafts present and counts of inscribed objects.
Inscribed objects linked to excavation units.
Seal widths (mm) and photo-based carver clusters, by CISI/ICIT id.

Each copper tablet with its type, picture and sign face.

Clay sealings (Lothal and others): number of impressions, back type (door, jar, bundle), context.
Masses and lengths of inscribed tools and objects from excavation reports.
Indus-related inscribed objects found outside South Asia (Gulf, Mesopotamia, Iran), with context and publication.
Texts of Indus-sign seals found abroad, with findspot, shape, animal and date.

Pottery marks from open-access reports.

Every harappa.com / HARP file located, with working URL, pixel size and terms note.

Inscribed or seal-bearing objects from 2015-2026 publications (Gulf, Oman, Iran, South Asia) checked against our corpora.
